verdict.rationale: The edison-client API supports submitting all named agent task types (Literature, Precedent, Analysis, Molecules, Kosmos), long-lived chat sessions with persistent sandboxes, file/directory uploads, and batch task management—mirroring the core UI-facing agent capabilities. However, no explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity exists, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec, leaving some UI-only features (e.g., billing, profile management) unconfirmed via API. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, discoverable OpenAPI/schema documentation, independent confirmation that all UI actions map to API endpoints.
